reviews.rationale: This is a vague evaluative judgment about an architectural approach, with no measurable criterion. As framed it is close to true by definition. Scoring it against one system substitutes the evaluator's interpretation for the speaker's words.

evidence.note: A peer-reviewed survey (February 2026) finds that significant reasoning failures persist despite progress.

The August 2025 version of this controlled study finds chain-of-thought reasoning brittle outside the training distribution. The models were small and trained from scratch, but this is still evidence of generalization weakness.
A January 2026 planning benchmark finds that state-of-the-art agents struggle significantly to produce valid complete plans.
MAKER (November 2025) shows that decomposition plus error correction can overcome the Hanoi errors. That mitigates the weakness but does not show it no longer recurs across models.

reviews.rationale: Several studies from within the period document recurring, material failures in reasoning (e1), generalization (e2), and planning (e3). MAKER shows the errors can be mitigated, not that the weaknesses have gone away.
